Name: Bookshelf Wallpapers for CP
Author: CommanderCorvus
Description:
Install Instructions: Unzip folder into Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods for use with Content Patcher.

Potential conflicts: Any other mods that replace or alter the walls_and_floors.xnb file. This mod should only edit the area of the two mentioned wallpapers.

Mods Included in Preview Images: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9081?tab=description]IdaIda's Furniture Recolor[/url] (it's really cute, check it out <3)

Manifest.Name: Bookshelf Wallpapers
Manifest.Description: Replaces sport ball and joja wallpapers with luxury and dark bookcase wallpepers, respectively.
Manifest.Author: CommanderCorvus
